why: Shimon Garti's May 2024 preprint 'Weak diamond and pcf theory' (arXiv:2405.03142) claims that, under mild assumptions, |pcf(a)| < |a|^{+3}, giving 2^{aleph_delta} < aleph_{|delta|^{+3}} for many strong limit singular cardinals of the form aleph_delta -- directly improving Shelah's ℵ_ω4 bound named in this bullet to an ℵ_ω3-type bound, though apparently only under stated hypotheses rather than unconditionally in ZFC.
